claim_verdicts.evidence: refs/web/slsa-levels.html (SLSA Specification 1.0, Security levels): "Build L1: Provenance exists. Summary: Package has provenance showing how it was built." Table: "Build L1 | Provenance showing how the package was built". §4 "Build L1 means provenance exists" matches; vi "Build L1 nghĩa là có provenance" matches.

refs/web/slsa-levels.html, Build L3 Requirements: "All of Build L2, plus: Build platform implements strong controls to: prevent runs from influencing one another, even within the same project. prevent secret material used to sign the provenance from being accessible to the user-defined build steps." §4 compresses this to "stops runs from affecting one another and keeps the signing material out of reach of the build steps"; same meaning, and consistent with the L2 reasoning that follows.

issues.quote: a commit id appears only in the provenance part
issues.text: Try it step 2 has me read a commit id after `sha-` on the first output line, outside the provenance part, so 'only in the provenance part' made me hesitate. I still pick c: option b and the misconception bullet tell me the tag is a label, and the signature block names no commit.
issues.fix: Narrow the clause to the checks: 'of the two checks, only the provenance part names a commit.'

issues.quote: In SLSA v1.0, Build L1 means provenance exists; L3 requires a build platform that stops runs from affecting one another and keeps the signing material out of reach of the build steps.
issues.text: The new sentence tells me what L1 and L3 mean, which gives me the reason Đơn Hàng is not L3 (any step can ask for the ID token). But L2, where Đơn Hàng actually stands, is never said to require anything beyond L1; I only know it from GitHub's statement. I can still answer q5, so it does not stop me.
issues.fix: Add one clause after the L1 definition saying what Build L2 adds over L1, if the SLSA source supports it; otherwise write 'L2 sits between them' so the reader knows it is a step up from L1.

issues.quote: GitHub states that its attestations alone reach SLSA v1.0 Build Level 2, and that Level 3 needs more isolation of the build. Đơn Hàng's is L2
issues.text: The same paragraph writes 'Build L1', 'L3', 'Build Level 2', 'Level 3' and 'L2'. I worked out they are one scale, but on first read I briefly wondered whether 'Build Level 2' was a different thing from 'L2'.
issues.fix: Use one form throughout the paragraph, e.g. 'Build L2' and 'Build L3' in the GitHub sentence too, or add '(L2)' after 'Build Level 2'.
